description:
No Inspect facility returns a binary. runtime render_value (runtime/src/any_value.rs:1440) backs dbg but prints. Elixir format must match: atom-keyed maps as `%{a: 1}`, quoted strings, charlists, `limit:` truncation (`...`). Used at distill lines 77, 90, 376.

Also (probed at 492b32fe1 for fz-sc8.18): dbg renders a struct as a bare tuple of its fields, '{"x.txt", [:raw, :read_ahead, :binary], nil}' for %Outer.Inner{path: "x.txt", modes: [...], node: nil}; Elixir prints '%Outer.Inner{path: "x.txt", modes: [...], node: nil}'. The renderer gains the struct form with its module name.

## Design review (2026-10-17)
The renderer behind dbg becomes Elixir-faithful (atom-keyed maps as a: 1, quoted atoms, ~c charlists, <<1::size(3)>>, limit:). dbg output changes with it: 14 expected files carry %{:a => ...} forms (e.g. fixtures/00306_atom_keyed_map.expected.txt, fixtures2/behavior/quicksort.expected.txt). Each re-bless is a move to Elixir's own text and is listed on the proposal page; oracle fixtures already expect Elixir's form.
title: inspect/1,2 returns Elixir's rendering, with limit:
